decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the change of use to a reception area to the existing storage facility, would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original building, the character of the street scene or to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
description: Change of use of existing mattress storage to form new reception area.
